subject: AWS listing entry review — SKU mapping & co-sell opt-in flow
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Amy Carter <amy@aws-partners.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@cloudedge.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft listing + SKU mapping for CloudEdge — need copy + co-sell opt-in answers

Team / Amy — attaching the first-pass AWS listing copy for CloudEdge (they're the target customer). Can you scan for the following items and reply with quick thumbs-up / edits?

- Hero one‑liner and 2-sentence detailed description (see doc, first two sections) — marketing wants clarity on what we're solving for buyers.
- SKU mapping: CloudEdge needs three SKUs (Standard, Enterprise, Dedicated). I drafted a CSV mapping to our internal plan names — please confirm if these map cleanly to AWS SKU fields (unit, billing cadence).
- Co-sell opt-in flow: AWS asked that we provide a short paragraph on partner enablement steps and a contact to be listed. Is Amy the right co-sell contact, or should we list Vanessa/Laura?
- Marketplace tile assets: see checklist in the PDF. Laura, any missing screenshots or technical artifacts?

Attachments: aws_listing_draft_v1.docx, sku_mapping_v1.csv, co-sell-checklist-aws.pdf

Next steps: If we can lock these by Thu (16th) EOD, we can submit for AWS preview next week. CloudEdge procurement (cc'd) is also waiting on the SKU details for procurement and PO paperwork.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft listing + SKU mapping for CloudEdge — need copy + co-sell opt-in answers

Rafael — quick pass from marketing side below. I'll inline comments against the doc as well, but high level:

- Hero one-liner: Keep it benefit-first. Suggest: "High-throughput LLM inference with predictable costs for production apps." (replaces our current draft).
- Detailed description: remove product-internal terms like "KV cache tuning profile" — buyers don't parse that. Replace with concrete benefits: latency targets, throughput, and deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private).
- Tile assets: Laura will confirm screenshots; we should also provide a short 30‑sec demo GIF.

For co-sell contact: Amy is fine as the official AWS channel. Vanessa and I should be listed as secondary contacts for technical and commercial follow-ups.

I'll drop inline suggestions in aws_listing_draft_v1.docx and share a revised hero image size.

— Vanessa
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood

From: Amy Carter <amy@aws-partners.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@cloudedge.com>, CloudEdge Procurement <procurement@cloudedge.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft listing + SKU mapping for CloudEdge — need copy + co-sell opt-in answers

Hi Rafael / team — thanks for the draft. A couple of quick notes from AWS Marketplace side: 

- SKU fields: AWS requires an explicit billing unit (e.g., vCPU-hour, instance-hour, per-user-month). "Standard/Enterprise/Dedicated" are fine as SKU names, but please add the unit and billing cadence in the CSV. I can send a template if helpful.
- Co-sell: we need a short partner enablement paragraph (1–2 sentences) and a named primary contact with email and phone for co-sell triage. Listing an AWS-facing contact (Amy) is OK, but we must include a customer-facing AE or SE to accelerate joint GTM. Please confirm phone numbers for the contacts you list.
- Security/Compliance blurb: buyers look for SOC2 + data residency bullets. If you can add a 1-line callout, AWS will surface it near the technical details.

I can accept the asset upload for a preview by next Tue (21st) if you have everything in place. Attached is an example SKU template and the standard co-sell checklist.

Best — Amy
Marketplace Partner Manager, AWS

Attachments: aws_sku_template.xlsx, aws_co-sell_requirements.pdf

Adding a pricing ops perspective: 

- Suggested mapping (from sku_mapping_v1.csv):
  - RDW-STD = Standard — unit: vCPU-hour, monthly billing; list price: $0.035/vCPU-hr
  - RDW-ENT = Enterprise — unit: vCPU-hour, monthly billing; list price: $0.028/vCPU-hr (volume tiers)
  - RDW-DED = Dedicated — unit: instance-hour, annual commitment; quoted per-customer

- Procurement note: CloudEdge will want a PO line-level description that matches AWS SKU names exactly. Recommend we publish SKU display names identical to the CSV "DisplayName" column.

I'll update sku_mapping_v1.csv with the units and example price bands and re-upload to the drive by EOD.

— Priyom
Senior Product Ops, Redwood
